privacy.title: Privacy information
privacy.intro: Soma is a free educational service at somarecovery.app. There is no advertising, no subscriptions, and no sale of personal data. Closed-beta sign-up is by invitation only. Contact email: soma.recovery.app@gmail.com. This text remains a draft.
privacy.knownBody: The service is offered at somarecovery.app. The controller is a natural person. The intended legal setting is Spain and European data-protection law. The operational contact is soma.recovery.app@gmail.com. The beta is limited to people aged 18 or over.
privacy.identityBody: The controller is a natural person. Legal identification (full name and an address or equivalent means required by law): [TO BE COMPLETED]. Until that appears here, this document is not ready to be published as a current notice.
privacy.purposeBody: Soma processes data to create and maintain an invited account, authenticate access, show educational recovery information based on what the person enters, send password-reset email, keep encrypted database backups, and allow account deletion. Data are not used for advertising or to commercialise profiles.
privacy.dataBody: Account: email, password stored as a hash, display name, birth year, biological sex, optional weight, and onboarding status. User-entered use: substances, dates, frequency, and status (for example abstinence). Journal: text and scales for mood, sleep, energy, anxiety, craving, and wellbeing. Product: missions, achievements, progress, and feedback messages. Session: technical refresh cookie, token hash, truncated user-agent, and, if recorded, a hash of a network identifier, not the raw address. Invites and password reset: token hashes only. On the develop codebase, ticked document boxes may also be stored (purpose, version, and date; no IP address).
privacy.specialBody: Information about substance use, abstinence, and wellbeing that the person types or selects may be health-related or otherwise special-category data under the GDPR. Soma does not claim that the current registration checkboxes are valid explicit consent under Article 9. If that consent is required, it must be specific, informed, unticked by default, and separate from the terms of use. Still pending legal confirmation: when to collect it (sign-up versus first substance or journal data) and the exact wording.
privacy.processorsBody: The current product uses: Render (website and API hosting), Supabase (PostgreSQL database), Resend (password-reset email), Cloudflare R2 (encrypted backup storage), and GitHub Actions (dump and encrypted upload). This draft does not claim that processor contracts are signed, nor a full list of sub-processors or regions. That remains pending legal confirmation.
privacy.transfersBody: Pending review. Some of the providers above may process data outside the European Economic Area. This draft does not describe standard contractual clauses, adequacy decisions, or other safeguards, because they are not confirmed.
privacy.retentionBody: Account and product data are kept for as long as the account exists. If the person deletes the account in the app, Soma deletes the user in the live database and, by cascade, associated product data. Exception: encrypted backups in Cloudflare R2 are retained for 7 days (daily copies) and 28 days (weekly copies) and may include a dump taken before deletion. Logs at Render, GitHub, and Resend follow those providers’ own periods, which are not confirmed here.
privacy.cookiesBody: Soma uses the HttpOnly cookie soma_refresh to keep the authentication session. It is not an advertising or audience-measurement cookie. The access JWT is kept in browser memory, not in local storage.
privacy.advertisingBody: There is no advertising, subscriptions, or paid features. Soma does not sell or commercialise personal data.
privacy.ageBody: The beta is restricted to people aged 18 or over. There is no technical age check beyond this rule and the invitation. Pending review: how that statement is recorded at sign-up.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and, where applicable, portability. In the product: profile editing, journal export, and account deletion. For everything else, email soma.recovery.app@gmail.com. Response deadlines, identity checks, and complaints to the Spanish Data Protection Agency remain pending legal confirmation. That email alone is not a complete rights procedure.
privacy.deletionBody: From the account you can delete the profile and product data in the live database. That does not immediately erase encrypted backups (7 and 28 days) or provider logs. No deadline is stated for total disappearance.
privacy.basesBody: Pending review. This draft does not choose or assert a legal basis under GDPR Article 6 or Article 9.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms are a draft for Soma (somarecovery.app). They are not a published contract.
terms.natureBody: Soma is an educational companion. Catalog curves, phases, and estimates are illustrative. They are not clinical measurements or a medical device.
terms.limitsBody: Trajectories do not predict individual recovery and do not replace a health professional’s judgement. In an emergency, contact emergency services, not Soma.
terms.medicalBody: Soma does not diagnose, prescribe, or provide individualized medical treatment.
terms.accessBody: During the beta, access is free, with no advertising and no subscriptions. Sign-up requires an invitation. There is no predetermined end date for the beta.
terms.ageBody: Only people aged 18 or over may register and use an account.
terms.accountsBody: The account is personal. The holder must keep their credentials and must not enter other people’s data. In this closed phase the operator may withhold or revoke invitations.
terms.advertisingBody: There is no advertising, payments, or sale of personal data under these terms.
terms.changesBody: Soma may change educational features or these texts during the beta. If a change is material for people who already have an account, they will be informed in an appropriate way (for example in the service or via the contact email). This draft does not set a specific notice period; that remains pending if the document is published.
terms.deletionBody: The account holder may delete the account from the application. The effect on backups is described in the privacy information.
terms.useBody: People who use Soma are responsible for how they interpret the educational information. This text does not attempt an absolute exclusion of liability or waivers of rights that cannot legally be waived.
terms.contactBody: Official contact: soma.recovery.app@gmail.com. The controller is a natural person. Intended setting: Spain and European law. Full legal identification is pending. Specific governing law and venue remain pending legal confirmation.
